headline: GIC Re Posts Q2 Profit Growth Supported by NSE Stake Sale
summary: General Insurance Corporation of India reported an 11.8% increase in investment income to ₹4,238.26 crore, boosted by gains from an offer-for-sale in the National Stock Exchange IPO, even as flood claims and health costs weighed on results.
why: GIC Re is India's largest reinsurer, providing reinsurance support to domestic and international insurance markets.

impacts.name: General Insurance Corporation of India
impacts.why: Investment income rose by 11.8% due to gains from the NSE stake sale.
